description: This Java class defines a REST controller named ClientResource that manages CRUD operations for Client entities via HTTP endpoints, utilizing Spring Framework annotations and services.

classes.name: ClientResource
classes.description: REST controller for managing Client entities, providing endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting clients.

methods.name: ClientResource
methods.description: Constructor injecting ClientService and UserService dependencies.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific client by ID.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all clients.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a client by ID.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new client associated with a user email.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing client associated with a user email.
